text: The SATA group is ultimately controlled by the Portuguese Autonomous Region of the Azores: the regional government owns SATA Holding, the parent of Azores Airlines, and is selling at least 75% of the airline in a privatisation process still running in September 2026.
short: The Regional Government of the Azores controls the SATA group and owns its holding company

source.name: European Commission press release: State aid: Commission approves €453.25 million Portuguese restructuring aid in favour of SATA Group (IP/22/3525)
source.quote: SATA Group is a regional airline ultimately controlled by the Portuguese Autonomous Region of Azores.

additionalSources.name: Herald News (Reuters/O Jornal): Eight investors eye majority stake in Portugal's Azores Airlines
additionalSources.quote: SATA Holding, which is owned by the Azores regional government, is seeking to sell at least a 75% stake in Azores Airlines
